content:
P11.1: Reactive ingress (bus -> workflow triggers). Closes the ADR-0007 trigger-ingress gap. TDD.

VERIFICATION (subscriber owner): the live subscriber is the toron-mcp serve path (spawn_mail_trigger_host -> WorkflowHost loops on BOTH serve_stdio + router(http)). toron-cli daemon.rs is lifecycle-only (no bus) — toron-cli needs NO wiring. The raw-bus run_trigger_loop (reservation/reaction triggers) exists but has ZERO production call sites = dead code. That is the gap.

SLICE:
(a) toron-workflow/src/trigger_filter.rs gains the ingress EVALUATION layer (moved from toron-mcp host): matches_trigger (kind-level + reservation acquired/released DISAMBIGUATION via released/revoked marker — today both map to kind==30031, a release fires BOTH triggers; + reservation project/path scoping + optional channel/emoji/project fields), trigger_payload (id/sender/content/kind/created_at/tags/project/channel/importance), trigger_run_id. Loop-prevention filter untouched.
(b) toron-mcp workflow_host.rs: delete local matches_trigger/trigger_payload, consume the toron-workflow ones.
(c) toron-mcp server.rs: spawn_trigger_loop (raw bus) ALONGSIDE spawn_mail_trigger_loop in the serve path — reservation_acquired/released + reaction_added go live.

GATES: workflow(trigger=reservation_acquired) fires when a 30031 acquired; reservation_released fires on release marker only; reaction_added on kind-7; message_posted NOT on workflow-emitted (loop-prevention holds); stamped events rejected.

TESTS: trigger_filter unit table (acquired/released/revoked/reaction/message/emoji/path/project); workflow_host integration over InProcessBus (over_bus + recording runner): acquire fires acquired-run only, release marker fires released-run only, kind-7 fires reaction-run, stamped kind-14 rejected.

FILES: crates/toron-workflow/src/trigger_filter.rs, crates/toron-mcp/src/workflow_host.rs, crates/toron-mcp/src/server.rs (all reserved).
